message.content:
I’m not sure there’s a dedicated “search security guard” tool available, but I can definitely point you toward some reliable ways to find a reputable guard in New York: | Method | What to look for | How to find it | |--------|------------------|----------------| | **Local security agencies** | • Licensed & insured
• Positive reviews & testimonials
• Specialization (e.g., event, corporate, residential) | • Google “security guard services New York City” or “security guard companies NYC”
• Check the agency’s website for client references and case studies | | **Online review sites** | • High rating (4 ★+)
• Recent reviews (last 12 months) | • Yelp, Google Reviews, Angi (formerly Angie’s List)
• Search “security guard NYC” and filter by rating | | **Professional associations** | • Membership in the International Association of Professional Security Consultants (IAPSC) or the National Association of Security Companies (NASCO) | • Visit their member directories or ask the agency for proof of membership | | **Industry certifications** | • Certified Security Guard (CSG) or Certified Protection Professional (CPP) | • Ask the guard or agency for certification copies; verify via the certifying body’s website | | **Local business directories** | • Chamber of Commerce listings, NYC Small Business Administration | • Search “security guard services” in the directory and read any available business profiles | | **Word‑of‑mouth** | • Ask colleagues, neighbors, or local business owners | • Use community forums like Nextdoor or local Facebook groups | ### Quick steps to get started 1. **Define your needs** – event security, corporate office, residential property, etc. 2. **Search online** – use the table above to filter agencies that match your criteria. 3. **Check credentials** – verify licensing, insurance, and certifications. 4. **Read reviews** – focus on recent feedback and any red flags. 5. **Request quotes & references** – ask for a written proposal and contact past clients if possible. 6. **Interview the guard** – if you’re hiring an individual, meet them in person or via video call to assess professionalism and communication skills. If you’d like, I can help you draft a request for proposals or suggest specific agencies that frequently appear in top reviews. Just let me know!
